grammar.statementSummary: chains (`a -> filter(…) -> sort(…)`) + SSA assignment, freely mixed; `=` is the one equality (`==` only in TTR-pandas, S9); multi-in named-only; union list-form (S11).

callFn.resolution: deploy-time against the manifest §15 registry; the pinned {id, version} is recorded in the entry record and honoured on replay (TTRP-EN-006 on a malformed or unresolvable call)

recipeGrammar.statementSummary: one `recipe { … }` per document, no `program` beside it: headers `key:` (an entity attribute, or a list for a composite key), `as of: now`, `parameters: [ … ]` (each a `def parameter` of the imports), `document:`, `protocol: always | on_route`; then one `candidates` island, any `context` islands (`target <engine>` + a body, or `builtin` / `foreign` / `call` / `turn`, an optional `window { by: …, over: … }`), one `decision <name>(in …)` ending in `<row> -> switch { mode: exclusive | overlapping, <route>: <condition> because: "…{column}…" detail: <context>, …, else: <route> | none }`, and `actions { <decision>.<route>, … -> <action> { column: value, … } when: <condition> }`. `:as_of` is the run's instant; `:name` a parameter. A duration is `30 days` / `2 working_days` in a header or a wiring value, and `days(30)` / `days(:param)` in an expression (`:as_of - days(30)`); the door does no other date arithmetic — count days with `age(since: …)` / `working_days(between: …, and: …)` in a calc.
